field.label: Direct domains / geosite
field.help: Comma or newline separated Xray domain rules, e.g. geosite:private. Direct rules take priority over proxy rules.

field.label: Direct IPs / geoip
field.help: Comma or newline separated networks or geoip categories, e.g. geoip:private,geoip:ru.

field.label: Proxy domains / geosite
field.help: Comma or newline separated rules, e.g. geosite:youtube. Import geosite.dat in General first. Domain matching for TUN traffic uses TLS/HTTP/QUIC sniffing where possible.

field.label: Proxy IPs / geoip
field.help: Comma or newline separated networks or geoip categories. Import geoip.dat in General first.

field.label: Bypass Networks
field.help: Comma-separated list of CIDR networks that should bypass the VPN tunnel and go direct. These networks will be routed via the 'direct' (freedom) outbound instead of the proxy.
